prompt: When does Anthropic say you can skip RAG entirely?

options.text: When the knowledge base is small enough to fit in the context window: put it all in the prompt, using prompt caching to cut latency and cost.
Never; every grounded application needs a vector database.
When the documents are in PDF format.
When the user questions are short.

explanation: The Contextual Retrieval post notes that a sufficiently small knowledge base can go straight into the prompt with no RAG, and prompt caching makes that faster and cheaper. As the knowledge base grows beyond the window, a scalable retrieval approach is needed.
